text: {"label":"Stimulus Preference Assessment Methods","definition":"Research on conducting, comparing, refining, and training stimulus preference assessments, including paired-stimulus, multiple-stimulus, and free-operant formats, stimulus presentation modes, social stimuli, and how well outcomes predict reinforcer value.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on preference assessment procedures themselves, not quantitative choice models, reinforcer variation and relative reinforcer value, or competing stimulus assessments for reducing problem behavior."}
